claims.text: **Block lemma.** Let \(M\in\mathbb Z^{R\times C}\), with finite ordered sets \(C=B\sqcup D\), and let \(P\subseteq R\), \(|P|=|D|\). Put \[ A=M[P,B],\qquad U=M[P,D]\in GL_{|D|}(\mathbb Z). \] If each \(r\in R\setminus P\) satisfies \[ M[r,B]=M[r,D]U^{-1}A, \] then the rows indexed by \(P\) generate the complete row lattice of \(M\). The Smith diagonal of \(M\) has exactly \(|D|\) nonzero entries, all equal to \(1\), and \(\mathbb Z^C/\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Z}(M)\) is freely generated by the images of the \(B\)-coordinate vectors.
